models.L077: Fictional free-energy diagram: reactants20,products5,peaks90/45; Ea70/25,deltaG−15 either way. Reaction coordinate is not time. Enzymes do not shift equilibrium or supply free energy and are regenerated overall; schematic omits pathways and cofactors.
models.L078: Four causal snapshots, not calibrated molecular time. Fictional A matches E and B does not; specificity includes chemistry and flexibility, not rigid geometry. One conversion accounting unit can represent several product fragments; substrate units+converted units conserved, enzyme unchanged. Zero substrate yields no new product. Turnover display is not a measured kinetic rate.
models.L079: Fictional enzymeE, separately prepared samples. Initial rate arbitrary units=100*exp(-((T−40)/width)²)*exp(-((pH−7)/2.2)²)*substrate/(substrate+2)*enzyme*remaining; width28 below40°C,14 above. Model optimum40°C,pH7 is not universal. Base enzyme1,substrate8 arbitrary concentration. Chilling leaves structure intact; rewarming to40°C restores rate. Prior75°C×10min assumed sufficient to inactivate92% irreversibly in E; cooling preserves this history. Slider changes assay conditions, not treatment history. Extreme-pH treatment reversibility, noise, actual folding and thermal exposure kinetics omitted. Relative index not capped100 for higher enzyme amount. No physiological or clinical rates.
models.L080: Selected digestive routes under suitable conditions. Amylase: starch→maltose/short oligosaccharides→other enzymes→glucose. Proteases: protein→peptides→further proteases/peptidases→amino acids. Intestinal pancreatic lipase primarily triglycerides→fatty acids/monoglycerides. Bile emulsifies without hydrolysis and is not an enzyme. No complete anatomy, molecular counts, absorption simulation or home bodily-fluid/tasting/pH experiment.
